items.source: Implementation of the JCacheOperationSource interface that reads the JSR-107 CacheResult, CachePut, CacheRemove and CacheRemoveAll annotations.
items.translation: 实现 `JCacheOperationSource` 接口，用于读取 JSR-107 的 `CacheResult`、`CachePut`、`CacheRemove` 和 `CacheRemoveAll` 注解。

items.source: The default JCacheOperationSource implementation delegating default operations to configurable services with sensible defaults when not present.
items.translation: 默认 `JCacheOperationSource` 实现将默认操作委托给可配置的服务，当这些服务不存在时则使用合理的默认值。

items.source: AOP-based solution for declarative caching demarcation using JSR-107 annotations.
items.translation: 使用 JSR-107 注解进行声明式缓存划分的基于 AOP 的解决方案。
